LESSON: INCOME AND BUDGETING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping (12 lessons) By the end of the sub strand, the 
Topic 5.2: Income and Budgeting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Income and Budgeting. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Income and Budgeting
2. Practise Income and Budgeting at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Income and Budgeting

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Income and Budgeting
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Income and Budgeting. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Income and Budgeting at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Income and Budgeting at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Income and Budgeting
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Income and Budgeting. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Income and Budgeting using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Income and Budgeting in the examples.
2. Explain Income and Budgeting to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Income and Budgeting.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Income and Budgeting using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Income and Budgeting important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Income and Budgeting
2. Practise Income and Budgeting at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Income and Budgeting

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
